name: Dyatlov Pass Incident
description: Nine experienced hikers died after cutting their way out of their tent at night in −25°C; some had severe internal injuries. Soviet files blamed an 'unknown compelling force', breeding infrasound, weapons-test, and yeti theories. 2019–2021 investigations and published slab-avalanche modelling support a small delayed avalanche plus hypothermia — contested but physically consistent.

name: Havana Syndrome
description: US and Canadian diplomats reported sudden neurological symptoms beginning in Havana. Hypotheses have ranged from directed energy weapons to cricket sounds and functional disorders; a 2023 US intelligence assessment deemed foreign-adversary involvement 'very unlikely', which some affected officers dispute. A live case of contested causation inside government itself.
